scripts.build: npm run build -w packages --if-present && npm run test:e2e && npm run docs:build
scripts.release:extension: npm run version:bump --workspace packages/extension && npm run build --workspace packages/extension && npm run sign --workspace packages/extension
scripts.submit:amo: npm run build --workspace packages/extension && npm run sign --workspace packages/extension -- --listed
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/userscript && npm run test --workspace e2e
scripts.test:e2e:extension:chrome: npm run build:chrome --workspace packages/extension && npm run test:extension:chrome --workspace e2e
scripts.test:real-world: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run test:real-world --workspace e2e
scripts.screenshots: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run screenshots --workspace e2e && npm run screenshots:real-world --workspace e2e
